eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
Required for admissions, scholarships, government jobs, and other state benefits.
Must have continuous residence proof or own property/land in UP.

required_documents_checklist.note: Auto-fetched during Aadhaar e-KYC with an option to update manually.
Standard government format downloadable from portal.

required_documents_checklist.doc_name_hi: राशन कार्ड की छाया प्रति अथवा बिजली का बिल
required_documents_checklist.note: Ration card, Electricity bill, Voter ID, or Water bill.
Optional but helpful if applying for educational purposes.

workflow_steps.details: User logs in with mobile number/email on edistrict.up.gov.in.
User inputs Aadhaar number and registered mobile number.
User receives and submits OTP on Aadhaar-linked mobile.
User fills personal details, address history, and uploads required documents.
Application routed to Lekhpal/Revenue Inspector for residential verification.
SDM or Tehsildar approves and issues the digital certificate.

vector_db_chunks.text: Service: Domicile Certificate (Niwas Praman Patra), Uttar Pradesh Revenue Department. Issued by SDM/Tehsildar via eDistrict UP portal (edistrict.up.gov.in). Mandatory ₹30 fee. Requires Aadhaar e-KYC OTP authentication. Essential for state scholarships and jobs.

Required Documents for Domicile Certificate (UP): 1. Applicant Photo (JPEG under 50KB). 2. Self-Certified Declaration Form (Swapramanit Ghoshna Patra). 3. Address Proof like Ration Card, Voter ID or Electricity Bill. 4. Educational Certificate (Optional).

Application Procedure: Log into edistrict.up.gov.in. Complete Aadhaar e-KYC via OTP. Fill address details and history of residence in UP. Upload photo, self-declaration, and address proof. Pay ₹30 fee online. Verification is done by Lekhpal/Revenue Inspector before SDM/Tehsildar issues the certificate.
